report:
Fresh review after adding target-line coverage: read the complete claim, the whole annotations.rs implementation, and all three associated tests printed by review start. The sole implementation association and all tests are ordinary; there are no TODO/N/A entries. All relevant helpers (tree construction, comment traversal, prefix classification, directive validation, target selection) are in the captured implementation file, so no additional production association is needed.

Implementation satisfies each requirement: real line comments yield byte-column prefixes; a non-whitespace prefix selects the current row. Otherwise reverse search selects the nearest preceding nonempty row outside annotation_only, skipping blank and consecutive annotation-only rows while retaining ordinary comments. No candidate produces an annotation-has-no-target error. All four kinds and conditional diagnostic forms pass through the same selection code and emit one-based target lines. Exact directive matching permits no caret/range arguments.

Test adequacy: all_directives_share_targets_and_reject_caret_and_range_syntax loops explicitly over ty, sym, ERROR, and WARN. Its visible source contains an inline marker, a blank row, and consecutive annotation-only markers; the asserted [2,2,2] verifies current-row selection and nearest-eligible backward selection for all four kinds. It separately checks the specific no-target error following leading blank/whitespace for each kind, and the specific malformed-directive error for caret and range suffixes for each kind. inline_stacked_and_blank_lines_use_one_rule asserts [2,2,2,6], additionally proving mixed marker kinds share selection and an ordinary comment is retained as the nearest target for a compiler-qualified ERROR. Its applies_to and tab checks are collateral assertions. only_real_line_comment_directives_are_interpreted rejects targetless ty/sym and malformed spellings, ignores string/block-comment lookalikes, and asserts an inline UTF-8 source target remains line 1. Together these tests cover every qualification in the claim and visibly assert expected outputs rather than relying on opaque verification helpers. No production defect or remaining coverage gap was identified.

Executed cargo fmt successfully and cargo test -p sage-test-harness --lib compile::annotations::tests: all three tests passed, zero failures (139 filtered out); existing sage-ir compiler warnings were emitted. Also executed fresh review start and review read of the review_scope claim. Workspace build and broader post-codegen/sanity checks are delegated to the coordinator and are not claimed as executed here.
